articles.title: Miraculous Corp Teams with ActivNation to Launch Branded FECs
articles.summary: Miraculous Corp and ActivNation have announced a partnership to develop Miraculous: Land of Heroes family entertainment centers, bringing the globally popular animated IP into the FEC space. This signals a growing trend of entertainment IP holders seeking brick-and-mortar FEC partnerships to extend brand engagement. FEC operators and developers should watch this deal closely as a model for IP-licensed venue concepts.

articles.title: Belgian Firm ProKarting Brings Multi-Level E-Karting Track Expertise to US Market at IAAPA 2026
articles.summary: ProKarting, builder of Europe's longest indoor e-karting track, will exhibit at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando and is already delivering multi-level go-kart tracks to US operators, including a recent installation at Epic Entertainment in Cincinnati. The company's modular multi-level designs could help FEC operators maximize revenue per square foot in constrained spaces. This is a significant development for operators considering go-kart attractions as a differentiating anchor experience.

articles.title: VAI Resort Expands Mattel City with Two Themed Hotels and New Attractions
articles.summary: VAI Resort and Mattel have announced a major expansion of Mattel City in Glendale, Arizona, adding two themed hotels and new attractions to what was formerly known as Mattel Adventure Park. The scale-up illustrates how IP-driven entertainment destinations are evolving beyond single-venue FECs into full resort ecosystems. FEC investors and developers should take note of the branded resort model as a potential growth trajectory.

articles.title: Netflix House Permanent Entertainment Venues Open in Philadelphia and Dallas
articles.summary: Netflix has opened two permanent 100,000-square-foot entertainment destinations at major US malls, blending free-to-enter spaces with ticketed immersive experiences, dining, retail, and regularly refreshed programming tied to new releases. The model presents both a competitive benchmark and a potential partnership template for FEC operators, particularly those in or near large retail centers. The mix of free entry with upsell experiences is a noteworthy revenue strategy worth studying.

articles.title: Kalahari Opens $900M Virginia Resort Featuring 175,000-Sq-Ft Indoor Water Park
articles.summary: Kalahari Resorts has opened its fifth location in Spotsylvania, Virginia, featuring the state's largest indoor water park alongside a 90,000-square-foot adventure park, 907 hotel rooms, and extensive convention space. The $900 million investment underscores the continued appetite for large-scale family entertainment resort destinations near major population corridors. For FEC operators, the integrated resort model combining water parks, adventure parks, and conventions represents an expanding competitive set.

articles.title: Elev8 Fun's Mall Redevelopment Signals Shifting Retail-FEC Landscape in Orlando
articles.summary: The Seminole Towne Center mall, home to the first Elev8 Fun location in Orlando, is incorporating Costco as an anchor tenant in a multi-phase redevelopment that will reshape the FEC's retail environment. The situation highlights a recurring challenge for mall-based FEC operators as retail anchor tenants change and mall footprints are reimagined. Operators with mall locations should monitor co-tenancy trends and redevelopment timelines as they plan their own expansions.

articles.title: American Resort Management Expands Leadership Team to Support Growing FEC Portfolio
articles.summary: American Resort Management has added several senior executives with backgrounds in hospitality, finance, HR, and marketing to support its expanding portfolio of family entertainment and resort destinations. The move reflects the increasing operational sophistication required to manage multi-unit FEC and resort brands. For the broader industry, it signals continued consolidation and professionalization within the FEC management sector.

articles.title: Betson Enterprises Named Exclusive US and Canada Distributor for ICE Tons of Tickets Ultra
articles.summary: Betson Enterprises has secured exclusive US and Canadian distribution rights for ICE's new Tons of Tickets Ultra ticket crane, set to debut at IAAPA Expo 2026. The partnership strengthens Betson's arcade redemption product lineup for FEC operators ahead of the holiday season buying cycle. FEC operators evaluating new redemption games should put this product on their IAAPA show floor visit list.

articles.title: Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Studio Partner to Bring Interactive Hasbro Robots to Attractions
articles.summary: Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Studio have announced a collaboration combining mobile expressive robots with AI-driven character authoring to bring Hasbro-branded interactive robot characters to location-based entertainment venues. This partnership points to a new category of interactive character experience that could appeal to FEC operators seeking premium, IP-backed attractions. The use of recognizable toy brand IP alongside responsive robotics could be a strong draw for family audiences.

articles.title: Immotion Expands VR Coaster Experiences to Observation Towers Globally
articles.summary: Immotion is rolling out bespoke VR roller coaster experiences at Sky Tower in Auckland and Mirador Torre Latino in Mexico City, creating location-specific immersive rides using drone-filmed aerial footage synchronized with motion seats. The model demonstrates how compact, software-driven VR attractions can be customized for unique venue settings with relatively low infrastructure requirements. FEC operators with rooftop or elevated spaces, or those exploring VR ride formats, should track this deployment approach.

articles.title: Silicon Arena Concept Proposes Human-Robot Competitive Gaming Zones for LBE Venues
articles.summary: Silicon Arena is a fully engineered but unbuilt LBE concept featuring modular 700–2,500 square meter arenas where guests physically compete against and collaborate with humanoid and mobile robots powered by embodied AI. Designed for science centers, commercial hubs, and flagship venues, the format represents a potential next-generation active gaming attraction category. FEC operators and developers should monitor this concept as robotic interactive gaming edges closer to commercial viability.

articles.title: Six Flags Appoints Adam Boal as Chief Procurement Officer
articles.summary: Six Flags has named Adam Boal as its new Chief Procurement Officer, bringing experience overseeing billions in corporate and client spend across procurement platforms and supplier partnerships. The appointment at one of North America's largest theme park operators may signal a push toward greater supply chain efficiency and vendor consolidation. Suppliers to major amusement and FEC operators should be aware of potential procurement policy shifts at Six Flags.

articles.title: California's Great America to Close Permanently After 2027 Season
articles.summary: California's Great America in Santa Clara has announced that 2027 will be its final operating season, ending a nearly 50-year run since opening in 1976. The closure of a major regional theme park represents a significant shift in the competitive entertainment landscape for Northern California. FEC operators in the region may see opportunities to capture displaced family entertainment demand.

articles.title: Disguise to Be Acquired by Yamaha Corporation
articles.summary: Media server and visual production technology company Disguise, which has grown significantly under Carlyle Group ownership, is set to be acquired by Yamaha Corporation. Disguise technology is widely used in immersive attractions, live entertainment, and themed experiences, making this acquisition relevant to FEC operators deploying high-end AV and projection systems. The deal could influence product roadmaps and support structures for venues relying on Disguise platforms.

articles.title: Christie to Present Projection Mapping Session at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Christie will host a Spotlight Session on projection mapping at IAAPA Expo 2026, with its technologies also featured at multiple partner booths across the show floor. Projection mapping is an increasingly popular tool for FEC operators looking to enhance theming and guest experience without costly permanent infrastructure changes. Attendees should prioritize this session for practical insights on deploying projection in FEC environments.

articles.title: XOrdinary Shift Platform Enables Attractions to Deliver Real-Time Adaptive Guest Experiences
articles.summary: XOrdinary has developed Shift, an intelligent experience engine that interprets live context and dynamically adjusts media, lighting, sound, show programming, and special effects across attraction venues. Unlike traditional programmed variation, Shift makes real-time decisions within operator-defined boundaries to create experiences that feel genuinely responsive to guests. FEC operators investing in immersive environments should evaluate this type of adaptive experience platform as a differentiator.

articles.title: Good Stuff Launches B2B E-Commerce Platform for Amusement Prize and Merchandise Ordering
articles.summary: Good Stuff, a major supplier of prizes and merchandise to the amusement and FEC industry, has launched a new B2B e-commerce platform designed to streamline ordering for arcade, carnival, and FEC customers. The platform aims to reduce friction in the procurement process, which could translate to time and cost savings for FEC operators managing redemption prize inventory. This is a practical operational upgrade worth exploring for venues sourcing prizes at volume.

articles.title: WhiteWater Appoints Michael Dalzell as VP of Global Marketing
articles.summary: WhiteWater, a leading waterpark and aquatic attractions manufacturer, has appointed Michael Dalzell as its new VP of Global Marketing, bringing over 20 years of experience in brand and customer experience strategy. The appointment signals continued investment in marketing capabilities at a key supplier to water parks and FEC resort operators. Operators working with WhiteWater on new installations or product evaluations may see updated commercial messaging and engagement approaches.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment Center has opened a new venue in Denton, Texas, expanding the brand's footprint in the North Texas market. New FEC openings in growing suburban markets highlight ongoing demand for family-focused active entertainment destinations. Operators and investors tracking competitive density in Texas should note this addition to the Denton market.

articles.title: AI World Models Raise New Governance Questions for Attraction Operators
articles.summary: A new analysis explores how AI-powered world models that predict and respond to crowd behavior and operational conditions in real time create complex decision-making challenges for attraction operators. The piece argues that while AI can forecast congestion and guest flow issues, the judgment calls about trade-offs must remain with human operators who understand the full context of their venue. FEC operators exploring smart operations technology should consider governance frameworks alongside technical deployments.

articles.title: GoGoXR Platform Layers Immersive VR Worlds onto Existing Swing Ride Motion
articles.summary: GoGoXR has opened Paper Dinosaurs at Wembley Park, a VR experience that transforms a standard swing ride into a prehistoric adventure by synchronizing immersive visuals with the ride's physical motion. The platform is designed to be scalable and operationally practical, enabling FEC operators to upgrade existing oscillating rides without replacing hardware. This approach could offer cost-effective experiential uplift for venues with legacy ride assets.

articles.title: Ellis & Associates Rebrands as Ellis International in Major Corporate Restructuring
articles.summary: Aquatic safety and risk management firm Ellis & Associates has rebranded as Ellis International and restructured its corporate leadership after more than four decades in the industry. The company provides safety training and operations management for water parks and aquatic attractions, making this restructuring relevant to FEC operators running water-based venues. Operators using E&A services should anticipate potential changes to program delivery and account management structures.

articles.title: Lake Compounce Announces 2027 Opening Day and Full Seasonal Event Lineup
articles.summary: Lake Compounce has announced a May 8 opening for its 2027 season, anchored by a centennial celebration of its Wildcat roller coaster alongside a full seasonal events calendar. The park's proactive multi-event programming strategy offers a useful model for FEC operators planning their own seasonal marketing calendars. Milestone anniversaries, in particular, can serve as strong anchors for media outreach and promotional campaigns.

articles.title: Omaha Property at 3002 Dodge Street Proposed for Conversion to Indoor Entertainment Venue
articles.summary: A commercial property at 3002 Dodge Street in Omaha is being considered for redevelopment as an indoor entertainment venue, reflecting broader trends of adaptive reuse of retail and commercial real estate for FEC concepts. The conversion of underutilized commercial space into entertainment destinations continues to be a viable path for FEC expansion in mid-sized markets. Developers and operators scouting locations should watch adaptive reuse opportunities in similar markets.

articles.title: Carowinds Launches WinterFest 2026 with Expanded Holiday Lighting and Programming
articles.summary: Carowinds has kicked off its 2026 WinterFest season with expanded lighting installations, festive live entertainment, seasonal food and beverage offerings, and ride operations running through January 3. Seasonal overlay events like WinterFest remain a proven revenue driver for amusement parks and larger FECs during the traditionally slower winter period. Operators planning their own holiday programming can draw inspiration from Carowinds' multi-layered seasonal approach.

articles.title: Schlitterbahn Galveston Rebrands as Texas Tides Water Park
articles.summary: The Schlitterbahn water park in Galveston, Texas, has been renamed Texas Tides Water Park, marking a brand transition for one of the Gulf Coast's most recognized waterpark destinations. Rebranding of established parks can signal ownership changes, strategic repositioning, or efforts to shed legacy brand associations. FEC and waterpark operators tracking competitive moves in the Texas market should note this shift.
